vision.name: Namekian Radiant Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever an Earth Dragon Ball you own enters play during combat, raise your anger 1. While 3 or more Earth Dragon Balls you own are in play, your attacks deal +2 life cards.
POWER: If less than 3 Dragon Balls you own are in play, search your Life Deck for a Dragon Ball and place it into play.
vision.note: portrait FanZ Mastery layout; title and number confirmed from a crop of the original
